retrieved_contexts:
[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 4. Loan amount and tenure]
4.1 Loan amount. Minimum loan amount is ₹5,00,000. Maximum loan amount is ₹7,50,00,000.
4.2 Tenure. Minimum tenure is 60 months (5 years). Maximum tenure is 360 months (30 years), subject to the age at maturity limits in clause 3.1.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 1. Purpose and scope]
1.1 Purpose. This policy sets out the eligibility, pricing, fees, security and prepayment terms for NexaHome Loan, a loan for the purchase, construction, extension or improvement of a residential property, or the balance transfer of an existing home loan.
1.2 Applicability. The version of this policy in force on the sanction date of a loan governs that loan for its life, except where a later instrument expressly states otherwise. Applications received under an earlier version but sanctioned after the effective date are governed by this version.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 6. Fees and charges]
6.1 General. All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally. Fees, once paid, are non-refundable except where this policy states otherwise.
6.2 Processing fee. Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.
6.3 Legal and technical charges. A non-refundable charge of ₹6,000 plus GST covers legal verification and technical valuation of the property.
6.4 Penal charges. Overdue amounts attract a penal charge of 2.00% per annum over the contractual interest rate, calculated on the overdue amount only. Penal charges are not compounded.
6.5 Other costs. Stamp duty, registration charges and insurance premiums are payable by the borrower at actuals and are not NexaBank fees.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 2. Definitions]
2.1 Defined terms. NRLR means the NexaBank Repo-Linked Rate published on the Rate Card. Bureau Score means the credit bureau score on the 300 to 900 scale pulled at the time of sanction. FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) means total monthly fixed obligations including the proposed EMI divided by net monthly income. Net monthly income means verified monthly take-home income for salaried applicants. Sanction date means the date on the sanction letter. Outstanding principal means principal disbursed less principal repaid.

[CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 5. Applicability and grandfathering]
5.1 Loans covered. The revised processing fee applies only to loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01. Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction, and no refund or adjustment is made.
5.2 Existing borrowers and part prepayment. Borrowers whose NexaHome loans were sanctioned under POL-HL-V3 before 2026-07-01 may opt in to the revised ₹10,000 part prepayment minimum by written request to their branch or through a service request. There is no charge for opting in. Until a borrower opts in, the ₹25,000 minimum continues to apply to that loan. Opting in does not change the processing fee already paid.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 8. Prepayment and foreclosure]
8.1 Foreclosure, floating rate. No foreclosure charge applies on a floating-rate loan, whether foreclosed from own funds or by balance transfer.
8.2 Foreclosure of fixed-rate loans. New sanctions are floating-rate only. Loans sanctioned under an earlier version's fixed-rate option keep the foreclosure terms of that version.
8.3 Part prepayment. Part prepayment is allowed at any time. The minimum part prepayment amount is ₹25,000. No charge applies on a floating-rate loan.
8.4 Notice. The borrower must give 3 working days notice for foreclosure or part prepayment.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 3. Eligibility] 3.1 Age. Minimum age at application is 21 years. Maximum age at application is 62 years for salaried applicants and 65 years for self-employed applicants. Age at loan maturity must not exceed 70 years (salaried) or 75 years (self-employed). 3.2 Minimum income. Salaried applicants must have net monthly income of at least ₹30,000. Self-employed applicants must have annual income of at least ₹5,00,000 as shown in the latest income tax return. 3.3 Bureau score. The minimum Bureau Score for the standard rate card is 675. For scores below 675, applications below this score are referred to manual underwriting and no standard rate is quoted. 3.4 FOIR limit. The maximum FOIR depends on net monthly income as shown below.

3.5 Applicant categories. The standard criteria in this policy cover salaried and self-employed applicants only. Other categories, including pensioners and those with no regular income, are outside the standard criteria and are handled by the branch on an exception basis.

[POL-HL-V3 | NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0 | 7. Security and loan to value] 7.1 Security. The loan is secured by a first mortgage on the residential property being financed. The property must have a clear and marketable title. 7.2 Loan to value (LTV).
